property_summary: For any two accounts, isApprovedForAll(owner, operator) must return the value that was last set by the owner via setApprovalForAll(operator, approved). The mutant swaps the mapping keys, so it returns whether the operator has approved the owner, not vice versa—thus it can differ whenever the two approvals are not symmetric.
change_summary: Change the mapping lookup to use 'operator' instead of 'account' as the first key.
